verdict_reason: New locators are well-scoped, role-based and tested by the linked spec; only a minor XPath-parent idiom to flag.

todos.issue: partyRow() ends with .locator('..'), which Playwright resolves as an XPath parent-axis selector — the best-practices doc explicitly flags XPath selectors as brittle/avoid
todos.fix: Prefer a role/structure-based ascent, e.g. filter the summary-list row directly (getByRole('group')/row-level locator) instead of climbing via XPath '..' from the term
